important_notes: A date in an SPO title is not itself a first-entry semester. Use transition clauses and explicit cohort labels.
Modulhandbuch is versioned within an SPO and may be updated for a new semester. An upload every semester is not mandatory if the applicable document is unchanged.
doc8 says Fachspezifisches Englisch is no longer offered; current substitution must be checked in the applicable handbook. Do not offer it automatically every summer.
Regelstudienverlaufsplan is recommended progression and seasonal planning, not proof of actual timetable availability.
External course codes, eligibility mappings and historical results must be versioned separately from these requirements.
